title: Target
description: Which knowledge base an operation acts on: a local clone's stack, or a codespace's. The launcher resolves it as the command line resolves --root and --repo, and refuses a choice it would have to guess.

kind.description: Where the stack runs: on this machine (local), or on a GitHub codespace whose knowledge base is forwarded here (codespace).

root.description: For a local target: the knowledge base's clone, by path or by the basename of a registered root, as --root takes it. Absent: the local stack the command line chooses with --runtime, standing where the control server was started.

repo.description: For a codespace target: the GitHub repository, as --repo takes it.
